compositing: for each part in draw_order: canvas = canvas*(1-matte) + matte (card holds out what lies behind); canvas *= (1 - ink). Back layer first, front layer (balloons, lettering, frames, marks) drawn last.
transform: world(part) = world(parent) @ L2P @ R(angle - base, pivot); array pixel -> local = + origin; R = visual counter-clockwise rotation in y-down coordinates

design_notes: Miller arm: the Busch arm (rest 52 deg at the shoulder) is too short to reach A without the hat brim crossing A (brim overhangs the cuff by ~18 u at 52 deg). The miller is therefore placed wholly left of A (body x <= 604) and a short pen sleeve (miller.forearm, elbow joint, rest 0) carries the arm to a cuff band at A; this removes the hard cut/white column at the seam.

Seam by construction: both sleeves end in the same cuff band segment (x A-20..wrist and B-20..wrist, shifted by D), and both wrists carry the same Busch hand cut at the same rest angle (40 deg), so the cuff at A and the wrist at B coincide exactly (measured residual 0 u for edges, width and slope).
Key pendulum lives only in shot 3 (before the art settles); it ends at the printed rest and the folded hold shows the printed key still (as proposed by the test-shot unit in amendments.md).
No plate backgrounds are carried: every figure is a card silhouette, so nothing ends in a rectangular crop edge.
